mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders (userId, businessId, orderDate, orderTotal, daId, orderState) VALUES (CAST(#{userId} AS CHAR), #{merchantId}, #{orderDate}, #{payAmount}, #{addressId}, IF(#{status} = 'PAID', 1, 0))
mapper.select: SELECT o.orderId AS id, CONCAT('NO', o.orderId) AS order_no, CAST(o.userId AS UNSIGNED) AS user_id, o.businessId AS merchant_id, b.businessName AS merchant_name, o.daId AS address_id, (o.orderTotal - b.deliveryPrice) AS goods_amount, b.deliveryPrice AS delivery_fee, o.orderTotal AS pay_amount, IF(o.orderState = 1, 'PAID', 'UNPAID') AS status, NULL AS remark, o.orderDate AS order_date, STR_TO_DATE(o.orderDate, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS created_at, NULL AS paid_at FROM orders o JOIN business b ON b.businessId = o.businessId WHERE o.orderId = #{orderId} LIMIT 1

SELECT o.orderId AS id, CONCAT('NO', o.orderId) AS order_no, CAST(o.userId AS UNSIGNED) AS user_id, o.businessId AS merchant_id, b.businessName AS merchant_name, o.daId AS address_id, (o.orderTotal - b.deliveryPrice) AS goods_amount, b.deliveryPrice AS delivery_fee, o.orderTotal AS pay_amount, IF(o.orderState = 1, 'PAID', 'UNPAID') AS status, NULL AS remark, o.orderDate AS order_date, STR_TO_DATE(o.orderDate, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS created_at, NULL AS paid_at FROM orders o JOIN business b ON b.businessId = o.businessId WHERE o.userId = CAST(#{userId} AS CHAR) ORDER BY o.orderId DESC
